gaps.empirical_consequence: Different row semantics change histories, ranks, projectors, and labels.
gaps.issue: The protocol does not state whether rows are origin snapshots or observation periods.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze the exact origin-by-series matrix construction and history windows.

gaps.empirical_consequence: Alternative shifts create different admissible panels and authorization rates.
gaps.issue: The one-calendar-month class-B stress is named but has no executable value/mask rule.
gaps.required_resolution: Define the exact series set, calendar shift, boundary missingness, and provenance fields.

gaps.empirical_consequence: Dropping rows makes the common-calendar projector undefined or incomparable.
gaps.issue: Complete-case fitting has no rule for recovering scores on the required 120 calendar rows.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze complete-row fitting and observed-row score recovery with failure conditions.

gaps.empirical_consequence: Order-dependent column retention changes channel weights and factor geometry.
gaps.issue: The bound method invokes a 0.98 near-duplicate rule, but Run 026 omits its graph and tie-break execution.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze connected-component construction and the complete deterministic representative tie-break.

gaps.empirical_consequence: Orientation gates and state-score summaries can change under arbitrary implementation choices.
gaps.issue: The signed eight-channel anchor is not a numerical vector and unequal-rank state alignment is undefined.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze the channel order, anchor vector, rank-invariant scalar projection, and normalization.

gaps.empirical_consequence: The same scenario can be accepted or rejected under multiple defensible readings.
gaps.issue: Within-panel quality gates and the role of expanding versus rolling fits are not enumerated.
gaps.required_resolution: Define each binary gate and which fit pairs enter within-panel and cross-scenario envelopes.

gaps.empirical_consequence: Primary benchmark loss and matched participation are not reproducible.
gaps.issue: B1 and B2 lack calibrated authorization statistics and B3 lacks an objective, penalty grid, solver, and failure rule.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze comparator estimands, cutoff grids, calibration losses, robust-PCA algorithm, and tie-breaks.

gaps.empirical_consequence: These controls cannot diagnose mechanical authorization or supply a pass/fail result.
gaps.issue: Channel-label and source-clock relabeling are algebraic invariances under the registered distances and deduplication.
gaps.required_resolution: Reclassify pure relabelings as invariances and register nondegenerate structure-breaking controls.

gaps.empirical_consequence: The success gate can be declared passed or failed after observing results.
gaps.issue: No numerical failure criterion is defined for any negative control.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze control-specific expected effects and exact rejection or non-inferiority rules.

gaps.empirical_consequence: Intervals are not byte-reproducible and may differ in small samples.
gaps.issue: Bootstrap seed, edge-block enumeration, zero-variance handling, and studentization are unspecified.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze the deterministic resampling stream and all finite-sample computational conventions.

gaps.empirical_consequence: Calibration choices and evaluation access cannot be independently audited.
gaps.issue: The protocol requires one-time evaluation but does not define lock artifacts, state transitions, or overwrite refusal.
gaps.required_resolution: Freeze a two-stage state machine with immutable calibration lock, evaluation marker, and hash chain.
